title: Squidgy Chocolate Truffles
description: Decadent dark chocolate truffles with a tang from low-fat cream cheese and a coating of cocoa powder. Slightly healthier than classic cream truffles.

ingredients.text: 1 x 180g tub of low-fat cream cheese

steps: Melt the chocolate in 20-second microwave bursts. In a separate bowl, whisk the cream cheese with a fork until soft.
Add a spoonful of melted chocolate to the cream cheese, stir, then add the whole cream cheese mixture to the chocolate bowl. Cover with cling film and refrigerate for 1–2 hours.
Sift the cocoa powder on to a plate. Roll fingerfuls of truffle mixture into grape-sized balls between your palms. Roll in cocoa powder until fully coated.
Place on greaseproof paper. Chill or leave in a cool place for an hour to set. Keeps in a tin for a week.
notes: Makes 24 truffles. Per truffle estimate. Coat in desiccated coconut, chocolate sprinkles or chopped pistachios instead of cocoa.
